--- # goimports-reviser ![logo](./images/reviser-muscot_200.png) Tool for Golang to sort goimports by 3-4 groups: std, general, company (optional), and project dependencies. # Shared helpers for the goimports-reviser golden corpus.

# Escape a literal string for safe use inside a sed BRE with '|' as delimiter.
gc_esc() {
  local s="$1"

  s="${s//./\\.}"
  s="${s//\*/\\*}"
  s="${s//\[/\\[}"

gc_norm() {
  sed \
    -e 's|^[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9] [0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9] |<TS> |' \

    "$1"
}

# gc_read_args <cmdfile> ; result in array GC_ARGS
gc_read_args() {
  GC_ARGS=()
  local line

    GC_ARGS+=("$line")
  done < "$1"

gc_make_work() {
  local cdir="$1" work="$2"
  mkdir -p "$work"
  cp -a "$cdir/." "$work/" 2>/dev/null || cp -R "$cdir/." "$work/"
  rm -f  "$work/cmd" "$work/expected.stdout" "$work/expected.stderr" "$work/expected.exit"
  rm -rf "$work/expected.tree"
}

# gc_ensure_go: make sure the `go` tool is reachable (needed by -rm-unused/-set-alias)
gc_ensure_go() {

#   * runs   <binary> $(cat cmd)   with cwd = that temp dir,
#   * normalizes volatile text (log timestamps, the temp path, the binary path,
#     the Go toolchain version),
#   * diffs stdout / stderr / exit code / resulting file tree against expected.*
#
# Exits 0 only if every selected case passes.
# Requires: bash, coreutils (cp/mkdir/rm/mktemp/basename), sed, diff.
# `go` must be on PATH for the cases that use -rm-unused / -set-alias.

set -uo pipefail

usage() { echo "usage: $0 /path/to/binary [name-filter]" >&2; exit 2; }

[ $# -ge 1 ] || usage
BIN_ARG="$1"
FILTER="${2:-}"

case "$BIN_ARG" in
  /*) BIN="$BIN_ARG" ;;
  *)  BIN="$PWD/$BIN_ARG" ;;
esac
[ -x "$BIN" ] || { echo "run.sh: not an executable file: $BIN" >&2; exit 2; }

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd -P)"
CASES="$HERE/cases"
[ -d "$CASES" ] || { echo "run.sh: no cases directory at $CASES" >&2; exit 2; }

# ---- make sure the go tool is reachable (needed by -rm-unused / -set-alias) --
if ! command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for c in /usr/local/go/bin /usr/lib/go/bin /usr/lib/golang/bin /opt/go/bin; do
    if [ -x "$c/go" ]; then PATH="$PATH:$c"; export PATH; break; fi
  done
fi
command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
  echo "run.sh: WARNING: 'go' is not on PATH; cases using -rm-unused/-set-alias will fail" >&2

# ---- helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------
esc() {  # escape a literal for a sed BRE that uses '|' as delimiter
  local s="$1"
  s="${s//\\/\\\\}"; s="${s//./\\.}"; s="${s//\*/\\*}"
  s="${s//\[/\\[}";  s="${s//\]/\\]}"; s="${s//^/\\^}"
  s="${s//\$/\\\$}"; s="${s//|/\\|}";  s="${s//&/\\&}"
  printf '%s' "$s"
}

TMPROOT="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/goldenrun.XXXXXX")"
cleanup() { [ "${KEEP:-0}" = 1 ] || rm -rf "$TMPROOT"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
[ "${KEEP:-0}" = 1 ] && echo "run.sh: keeping work dirs under $TMPROOT" >&2

MAXDIFF="${MAXDIFF:-60}"

pass=0; fail=0; skipped=0
declare -a FAILED=()

for cdir in "$CASES"/*/; do
  cdir="${cdir%/}"
  name="$(basename "$cdir")"
  if [ -n "$FILTER" ]; then
    case "$name" in *"$FILTER"*) ;; *) skipped=$((skipped+1)); continue ;; esac
  fi
  if [ ! -f "$cdir/cmd" ]; then
    echo "FAIL $name (no cmd file)"; fail=$((fail+1)); FAILED+=("$name"); continue
  fi

  out="$TMPROOT/$name"; work="$out/work"
  mkdir -p "$work"
  cp -a "$cdir/." "$work/" 2>/dev/null || cp -R "$cdir/." "$work/"
  rm -f  "$work/cmd" "$work/expected.stdout" "$work/expected.stderr" "$work/expected.exit"
  rm -rf "$work/expected.tree"

  # arg list: one argument per line, verbatim (empty file => no arguments)
  ARGS=()
  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do ARGS+=("$line"); done < "$cdir/cmd"

  WORK_PHYS="$(cd "$work" && pwd -P)"

  ( cd "$work" && exec "$BIN" ${ARGS[@]+"${ARGS[@]}"} ) >"$out/stdout" 2>"$out/stderr"
  code=$?
  printf '%s\n' "$code" > "$out/exit"

  norm() {
    sed \
      -e 's|^[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9] [0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9] |<TS> |' \
      -e "s|$(esc "$WORK_PHYS")|<CWD>|g" \
      -e "s|$(esc "$work")|<CWD>|g" \
      -e "s|$(esc "$BIN")|<BIN>|g" \
      -e "s|$(esc "$BIN_ARG")|<BIN>|g" \
      -e 's|^built with: go[0-9][0-9A-Za-z.+-]*$|built with: <GOVER>|' \
      "$1"
  }
  norm "$out/stdout" > "$out/stdout.norm"
  norm "$out/stderr" > "$out/stderr.norm"

  ok=1
  : > "$out/report"
  for part in stdout stderr exit; do
    exp="$cdir/expected.$part"
    [ -f "$exp" ] || : > "$TMPROOT/empty.$part"
    [ -f "$exp" ] || exp="$TMPROOT/empty.$part"
    case "$part" in
      exit) got="$out/exit" ;;
      *)    got="$out/$part.norm" ;;
    esac
    if ! diff -u "$exp" "$got" > "$out/diff.$part" 2>&1; then
      ok=0
      { echo "--- $part differs (expected vs got) ---"; head -n "$MAXDIFF" "$out/diff.$part"; } >> "$out/report"
    fi
  done

  treeref="$cdir/expected.tree"
  if [ ! -d "$treeref" ]; then
    # No recorded post-run tree: the input tree itself is the expectation.
    treeref="$out/inputcopy"
    mkdir -p "$treeref"
    cp -a "$cdir/." "$treeref/" 2>/dev/null || cp -R "$cdir/." "$treeref/"
    rm -f  "$treeref/cmd" "$treeref/expected.stdout" "$treeref/expected.stderr" "$treeref/expected.exit"
    rm -rf "$treeref/expected.tree"
  fi
  if ! diff -ru "$treeref" "$work" > "$out/diff.tree" 2>&1; then
    ok=0
    { echo "--- resulting file tree differs (expected vs got) ---"; head -n "$MAXDIFF" "$out/diff.tree"; } >> "$out/report"
  fi

  if [ "$ok" = 1 ]; then
    echo "PASS $name"; pass=$((pass+1))
  else
    echo "FAIL $name"; cat "$out/report"; fail=$((fail+1)); FAILED+=("$name")
  fi
done

echo
echo "================ summary ================"
echo "passed:  $pass"
echo "failed:  $fail"
[ "$skipped" -gt 0 ] && echo "skipped: $skipped (filter '$FILTER')"
if [ "$fail" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "failing cases:"
  for f in ${FAILED[@]+"${FAILED[@]}"}; do echo "  - $f"; done
  exit 1
fi
echo "ALL PASS"
exit 0
RUN
chmod +x /tmp/golden/run.sh; echo ok
